scope: Li-ion crystalline or phase-resolved controls with literature evidence relevant to Rhombus P0-through-Application external-validity falsification; no DEV/HELD_OUT assignment
selection_principles: include both high-mobility and demonstrably poor-ion-conductor controls
span multiple chemistry families rather than optimize for one family
prefer primary peer-reviewed sources with phase-resolved experimental evidence
retain phase, disorder, microstructure, temperature, and composition dependence instead of collapsing to a formula label
do not treat ionic conductivity as self-diffusion truth
do not promote an entry to a B1 truth bundle until exact structure and evidence provenance are bound
do not assign DEV or HELD_OUT membership in B2

rationale: primary report describes 12 mS cm^-1 room-temperature ionic conductivity

entries.phase_context: cubic Ia-3d Al-stabilized LLZO at 300 K, bound to COD 7215448 / Buschmann et al. specimen

transport truth must remain bound to this exact composition and phase rather than the nominal Li7La3Zr2O12 formula

entries.phase_context: crystalline Li3N; impurity/doping and anisotropy must be recorded explicitly
rationale: multiple experimental reports identify Li3N as a strong lithium-ion conductor
independent reports expose doping and anisotropy effects that must remain in scope
primary 7Li PFG-NMR directly measures lithium self-diffusion in crystalline alpha-Li3N from 534 K to 774 K and reports anisotropic transport with 0.150 ± 0.009 eV activation energy within Li2N layers
